_doc: Project-level settings.json template installed by 'yakos init'. Hook commands resolve to <project>/scripts/hooks/. Remove this _doc key after customizing — it is informational only and unused by Claude Code.

hooks._doc: retro-dispatch runs after cycle-counter so the .retro-due marker is already written when this fires.

PreToolUse._doc: v0.34 budget-guard runs on every tool call; no-op when .yakos.yml has no budget block

PreToolUse._doc_hook_order: telemetry-first (path-log preserves audit even when later hooks block), then ascending by cost. supervisor-gate is cheap FS lookup; peer-claim is cheap FS lookup; path-allowlist is cheap JSON lookup; secret-scan is most expensive (regex over full content).

hooks._doc: Phase 2 plan-quality-gate PreToolUse path: blocks TeamCreate|Agent when .plan-blocked marker is present. Override with 'yakos plan score override <plan_id> --reason ...'

PostToolUse._doc: Plan 1 M2 — flips peer-claim intent → confirmed and rebuilds active-claims.json. No-op when multi-dev coord is not enabled.
Phase 2 plan-quality-gate: auto-scores work/current/plan.md on write. Surfaces or blocks when aggregate score < threshold. No-op for non-plan.md writes. Conservative: infra errors → WARN + PASS.

v0.34 supervisor: stream mutation tool calls to the rolling buffer; pre-filter sieves noise before any LLM dispatch. Reads override per .yakos.yml supervisor.matcher. No-op when supervisor not enabled in .yakos.yml.
v0.33 output-injection scanner: scans every tool output for prompt-injection patterns. Kept on '*' — reads are the injection attack surface, not just writes.

Stop._doc: M3.1 auto-compact: checks for .compact-pending marker (written by context-threshold when context_thresholds.auto threshold is crossed) and injects /compact as the next turn. Opt-in via 'yakos compact threshold --auto 85'. No-op when marker absent or auto not configured.

hooks._doc: Phase 3 plan-quality: best-effort outcome capture for any open plan_id. Non-blocking; writes null for fields it cannot compute. Skipped when 'yakos work close' was already run.
